name: Zion cinematic lighting
intent: Warm, gracious, heavenly light with legible detail and controlled highlights.
guidance: This preset guides new projects and does not override approved film-specific art direction.
Avoid white-outs, flashing text, harsh camera snaps and bright effects across words.
Typography and official emblems should use approved assets with unchanged wording and proportions.
Blender and Three.js view transforms are different; judge matched full-resolution reference frames.
Record parameters in each renderer, since guidance fields are not automatically shader uniforms.
